title: Poland
data: 29,790 polling districts (2025 map; earlier districts carried onto it by an address-point crosswalk), Sejm elections 2019 and 2023, votes for PiS, KO, Lewica, PSL / Trzecia Droga and Other (Konfederacja, German Minority and minor lists)
why: K = 10, against K = 5 (only these two fitted, five starts each; BIC 2,082,589 and 2,116,238); all five K = 5 starts reach the same partition, but only one of five K = 10 starts reaches the best fit, so the smaller K = 10 blocs are provisional; the globe shades the K = 5 blocs, each gmina taking the bloc of most of its 2023 voters

pca.cap: Rotating principal coordinates (Jensen-Shannon distance) of the districts' 2019 and 2023 vote shares, coloured by the K = 10 blocs; dot area proportional to 2025 residents. Landmark classical scaling (3,000 random landmarks).

map.cap: Bloc map, K = 10, drawn on the 2025 polling districts (each 250 m cell takes the district of its nearest address point). Legend: mean 2023 shares of each bloc and its number of districts. Blocs numbered by 2023 PiS share, lowest first.

heat.cap: List vote shares in 2019 and 2023 (columns), one row per polling district, grouped by K = 10 bloc and ordered by 2023 PiS share. Hover for a district's share, click to pin it; hover the bloc bar for the bloc's averages.
